extraction.coordinate_note: The historical regimes are reported along the dag_size LAYER coordinate of a fixed synchronous universe (a foliation of a completed object), not along engine steps; the source itself stresses that step and dag_size are different quantities and flags the late layers as truncation-mixed. Historical numeric layer boundaries (9-12, 12-13, 13-14, 14-15) and the K9/80-percent figures are recorded as historical values only, playing no role.

historical_observables.definition: for each registry object w and layer d: the number of dag-size-d objects containing w as a complete ancestral sub-DAG
historical_observables.name: exposure / containment

historical_observables.definition: number of registry pairs co-embedded in the same host object, per layer
historical_observables.direction: broadens in later layers; coembedding clock advances fastest (R3 ~ 1.42 > 1)
historical_observables.name: pair co-embedding

historical_observables.definition: count of spatial-81 pairs with nonzero co-embedding weight at layer d
historical_observables.direction: up in broadening, contracts at freeze-out, constant in locking, slightly down in concentration
historical_observables.name: support size (nonzero spatial pairs)

historical_observables.definition: diversity measures of the spatial-pair weight distribution at layer d
historical_observables.direction: up in broadening; down from freeze-out on
historical_observables.name: visibility / entropy-effective support / participation ratio

historical_observables.definition: high-percentile thresholding of persistent pair weights across layers 13-15; the surviving clique
historical_observables.direction: rising late; collapses onto the 9 spatial degree-136 bedrock nodes
historical_observables.name: concentration measures / weighted backbone

historical_observables.definition: total root-to-node directed paths in G_s; tau ~ log log(total paths)
historical_observables.name: total directed paths (global clock candidate)

historical_observables.definition: log log of registry containments / pair coembeddings
historical_observables.direction: increasing; faster than the global clock (R2 < 1)
historical_observables.name: registry containment / coembedding clocks

historical_observables.definition: step-s objects have degree exactly 2 (no children); step-<s objects saturated - the shell is the childless population
historical_observables.name: shell / two-epoch stratification

historical_observables.definition: count of objects at each dag_size
historical_observables.direction: each layer count nondecreasing in time; the unimodal G_6 profile is flagged by the source as truncation-mixed
historical_observables.name: dag_size layer populations

historical_observables.definition: degree distribution of the DEU foam carrier supergraph
historical_observables.direction: power-law; historically shown NOT to match the registry (negative result)
historical_observables.name: foam hub degree distribution (CARRIER_HUB_NULL)

historical_observables.definition: Metropolis dynamics on the co-embedding lattice with interface-mediated condensation
historical_observables.direction: matter-like condensation requires the interface sector
historical_observables.name: sector condensation dynamics (HetSim)

historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.label: registry formation / global illumination
historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.report: 137-object DAG-7 registry closes; 'by DAG-8, all registry nodes are already present in higher-layer exposure' - the first lights-on result

historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.label: broadening
historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.report: support grows, visibility rises, effective support increases - more spatial interaction modes active

historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.label: freeze-out onset
historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.report: support breadth contracts, effective pair diversity falls, but total pair weight continues to rise - concentrating interactions into fewer channels

historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.label: support locking
historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.report: the support set remains the same, but the surviving channels intensify - frozen in topology, not in weight

historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.label: late concentration
historical_regime_sequence_verbatim.report: support shrinks a little further, concentration rises further; the 95th-percentile weighted persistent backbone collapses exactly onto the 9-node spatial bedrock (K9)
